knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says a clear quote lists each room and item on its own line, with the method and exclusions stated. A single low price with no method, and a promise that every stain will be removed, are both ruled out.

The lesson says a low per-room offer can be a basic one-step process, so the first check is whether the lower price covers the same method and steps as your quote. Room count or house size is not the test.
The lesson says extra work found after the quote should be priced in writing and permission obtained before doing it. Doing it first, or skipping it, are both ruled out.

practicalCriteria: Applies the step to a real or simulated business decision and records the outcome
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Written output of the step (plan, offer, log or record)
stopWorkCriteria: Not applicable: business guidance; stop if an offer would make an unsubstantiated or misleading claim
